scope: All 48 ordinary armor-set reviews: released callback routes, cross-class effects, attribute inputs and explicit unresolved summon paths. Static inspection, no game execution or full runtime certification.

alacrity.summary: The full-set invulnerability callback checks the fall-damage tag. The partial-set incoming-damage callback checks only absence of FULL_SET before adding an armor-stage reduction; it has no fall-source guard in this method. Its lambda uses equippedPieces.size × 0.2.
alacrity.status: Tooltip/implementation scope mismatch requiring target-build review; no observed combat bug or applied fix.

embrodium.summary: Server-player tick callback reads Spirit per-tick regeneration (fallback 0.04). Full set adds 0.25×regen. Above ambient temperature 0.8, it additionally adds perPieceValue(0.25×regen)×min(1,temperature/2); only positive totals are submitted. This is an extra resource request, not a measured final recovery rate.

hazmat.summary: FULL_SET plus air below maximum triggers setting air to maximum. The airtight helmet method separately calls PlayerUtil.isWearingFullSet for its material.

ice.summary: Server-side inventoryTick requires numeric slotId 36–40 inclusive, a LivingEntity wearer, damage>0, random nextFloat<0.02 and ambient temperature<0.15. It then subtracts one damage point. These are callback gates, not proof that every engine inventory slot invokes this hook identically.

infernal.summary: Incoming damage must match IS_FIRE before adding a reduction with perPieceValue(0.15). Full-set fire-tag invulnerability is a separate callback. The reduction helper acts on remaining damage at its stage.

lyndamyte.summary: Retaliation requires positive new damage, server side, a melee source and a RandomUtil.percentChance call with perPieceValue(0.25); it requests five seconds of fire on the source entity. Full-set outgoing melee attacks separately request five seconds of fire on the target. External random-helper semantics and final immunity/hooks remain separate.

skeletal.summary: For a ServerPlayer with saturation<1 and FULL_SET, the callback saves the food level, calls FoodData.eat(1,0.5), then restores the food level. This is saturation maintenance rather than a direct command to set a full hunger bar.

void.summary: Requires positive new damage, a LivingEntity attacker and a melee source. RandomUtil.percentChance receives 0.2 for FULL_SET, otherwise perPieceValue(0.025). Successful calls build MOVEMENT_SLOWDOWN with duration input 30 and level input 20 for the attacker. The full-set branch is a total input, not a second additive random roll.
void.status: Selected branch checked; EffectBuilder level/duration interpretation not reimplemented

wither.summary: Incoming reduction requires the IS_WITHER tag and perPieceValue(0.25). Full set plus that tag sets invulnerability and builds DAMAGE_RESISTANCE with duration input 60, ambient and hidden-icon flags. The effect is requested on a qualifying damage check, not merely because a status-effect icon exists.

ghoulish.summary: The local outgoing callback multiplies energy-tagged damage input by 1 + perPieceValue(0.1). Separately, AoABlaster.getSpiritCost applies a full-set multiplier of 0.7 after Spirit/ammo enchantment adjustments. Non-player shooters, infinite-material consumption and weapon overrides have separate paths; this does not make every weapon 30% cheaper.
ghoulish.status: Local damage and external cost routes checked

hydrangic.summary: The armor class only supplies its tooltip; the effect is in PlayerEvents.onBlockPlace. It requires a ServerPlayer, the Hydrangic full set, a placed CropBlock and successful BoneMealItem.applyBonemeal. It then emits growth effects and calls hurtArmor with generic damage input 16. That input is not a claim of exactly 16 durability lost per item or guaranteed instant crop maturity.

nightmare.summary: ItemUtil.findAndConsumeRunes enables the armor adjustment only when allowBuffs is true and the full set is recognized. After the rune-cost enchantment stage, the lambda removes Distortion Rune requirements and applies max(cost − 1, 1) to other runes; an ammo-cost enchantment stage follows. A one-rune requirement therefore does not become free from the armor subtraction alone. Infinite-material callers and stored staff charges can bypass this payment route.
nightmare.status: External rune-payment route and lambda checked

speed.summary: Four slot-specific MOVEMENT_SPEED modifiers each use amount 0.1 with ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL. The FULL_SET equip callback applies a separate transient modifier of the same amount/operation; the matching unequip callback removes it. These are independent attribute operations, not a proof that adding five displayed percentages gives the final movement speed.
speed.status: Slot modifiers and full-set equip/unequip pair checked

knight.summary: Each ordinary slot supplies +5 MAX_HEALTH using ADD_VALUE. The tick effect requires FULL_SET, a living wearer and health fraction below 0.2; it builds DAMAGE_BOOST with duration input 2 and level input 2. Maximum health is not the same as healing current health, and effect-builder inputs are not independently simulated here.
knight.status: Slot modifiers and low-health gate checked

phantasm.summary: Each ordinary slot supplies +1 LUCK using ADD_VALUE. That is an attribute increase, not a universal extra-drop percentage; the particular loot table must actually use luck for it to affect that outcome.

purity.summary: The inspected onEquip callback removes existing Weakness, Slowness, Mining Fatigue, Blindness and Nausea without a FULL_SET guard in that method. Separately, onEffectApplication requires FULL_SET before rejecting those five future effects. Clearing an existing effect on equip and preventing reapplication are distinct gates; verify transitions rather than treating a single piece as permanent immunity.
purity.status: Equip-time cleanup versus full-set prevention distinguished

subterranean.summary: FULL_SET equip applies a transient ATTACK_SPEED modifier of −0.16666667 using ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL, and unequip removes it. The full-set tick callback also builds DIG_SPEED with duration input 2 and level input 2, hiding particles. Preserve the tradeoff and its cleanup when porting; the tooltip alone does not enumerate every attribute operation.
subterranean.status: Attribute tradeoff and full-set effect callback checked

archaic.summary: Outgoing melee damage input is multiplied by 1 + perPieceValue(0.1875) × (1 − wearer health fraction). Without FULL_SET, incoming damage input is separately multiplied by 1 + perPieceValue(0.16) × missing-health fraction. The partial-set vulnerability is a tradeoff; full-set recognition removes that particular incoming penalty.
archaic.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

baron.summary: The inspected class declares its constructor and durability tooltip, with no local effect callback. Its registered durability multiplier is 150 in the separate material evidence. High durability is established; an additional combat ability is not inferred from the name.
baron.status: Durability claim supported; no extra ability inferred

battleborn.summary: Outgoing melee attacks by a ServerPlayer add perPieceValue(6) to an armor cooldown counter, capped at 300, then apply an ATTACK_SPEED modifier with amount min(0.65, counter/240) and ADD_MULTIPLIED_TOTAL. The tick callback refreshes on game-time multiples of 10 and removes at counter 1. Removing the last counted piece removes the modifier and retains 75% of a positive counter. Shared cooldown behavior and re-equip cleanup still need target-build testing.
battleborn.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

biogenic.summary: Full-set ticks in water write air supply −10. Water-at-eye level separately requests NIGHT_VISION with duration input 300; leaving that eye-fluid condition or breaking the set removes a night-vision instance only if its duration is at most 300. Positive melee damage from a living attacker requests slowness with duration input ceil(newDamage × perPieceValue(3)) and level input 2 when the EnumSet size is at least two, otherwise 1. The negative air write deserves underwater testing; it is not the Hazmat maximum-air restoration path.
biogenic.status: Negative air write requires underwater acceptance; no observed drowning outcome claimed

boreic.summary: Positive, non-environmental damage while the wearer is in water starts the boreicArmour explosion definition, passing equippedPieces.size. FULL_SET also selects probable enemies within radius input 4 and requests slowness with duration input 40 and level input 2. Explosion damage, block effects and ownership need the separate explosion definition; they are not guessed from this callback.
boreic.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

candy.summary: A hungry ServerPlayer may auto-consume qualifying inventory food when FULL_SET is present or the armor cooldown is inactive. Food must report positive nutrition and saturation. The found item executes finishUsingItem and its returned stack replaces that slot. Successful use sets cooldown input 12000 / counted pieces. FULL_SET bypasses the cooldown gate in this method, so inventory-consumption behavior deserves explicit testing.
candy.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

commander.summary: On wearer tick counts divisible by 20, the callback selects other living entities whose resolved player/owner is the wearer, within radius input perPieceValue(2). It requests DAMAGE_BOOST with duration input 25 and level input 2 for FULL_SET, otherwise 1. It does not buff every nearby creature or every teammate indiscriminately.
commander.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

crystallis.summary: Positive damage from a living attacker must not bypass armor. Melee qualifies; ranged damage additionally requires FULL_SET. The callback requests thorns damage equal to newDamage × perPieceValue(0.25), then calls hurtArmor with generic damage input newDamage × 2. Reflection and durability loss are separate engine operations, not guaranteed final health/durability amounts.
crystallis.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

elecanyte.summary: Positive non-environmental damage to a ServerPlayer requests Spirit equal to newDamage × perPieceValue(2.5). Resource caps, resource modifiers and other callbacks still apply; this is not an uncapped Spirit balance guarantee.
elecanyte.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

exoplate.summary: For non-environmental incoming damage in a ServerLevel, the callback computes light = clamp(2 + the queried light level, 2, 15). Its armor-stage reduction fraction is (1 − light/15) × perPieceValue(0.0625). It therefore depends on the checked light helper and is not a flat bonus in every location.
exoplate.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

explosive.summary: Incoming damage must match IS_EXPLOSION before adding an armor-stage reduction using perPieceValue(0.15). FULL_SET explosion-tag invulnerability is a separate callback. Other damage types are not covered by this local gate.
explosive.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

fungal.summary: Positive melee damage must pass RandomUtil.percentChance(perPieceValue(0.2)). A living attacker then receives a poison request with duration input 60 and level input 2. Inside that successful outer branch, FULL_SET plus a separate one-in-four helper roll requests level-input-1 poison on probable enemies within radius 5. The area roll is nested, not an unconditional 25% event on every hit.
fungal.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

ghastly.summary: The tick condition branches to isShiftKeyDown only when tickCount % 5 == 0 and the wearer is a Player; otherwise it evaluates isCrouching. A true result selects probable enemies within perPieceValue(4) and requests GLOWING with duration input 6. The released branch therefore does not impose a universal once-every-five-ticks scan limit. Review crouching scan frequency and intended behavior before making a performance claim.
ghastly.status: Branch-frequency review target; no measured FPS or timing claim

hydroplate.summary: While in water, each armor tick requests healing of perPieceValue(0.0125). Separately, FULL_SET plus water plus non-environmental incoming damage installs an armor-stage fraction of 0.2. Healing caps and final damage depend on the engine and hooks.
hydroplate.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

lunar.summary: Each armor tick requests JUMP with duration input 2 and level input equal to counted pieces, marked ambient with hidden particles. EffectBuilder level semantics and actual jump motion are not independently simulated in this documentation.
lunar.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

lyonic.summary: On even world-game ticks, the callback searches within perPieceValue(2.5), then pulls eligible entities with strength input 0.05. Nonempty item entities must have no pickup delay. FULL_SET also admits experience orbs and eligible embedded arrows; that arrow branch clears inGround, sets base damage to zero, nudges upward and marks motion for synchronization. It is not a promise to vacuum every item or hostile projectile.
lyonic.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

mercurial.summary: After positive explosion-tagged damage, the callback requests DAMAGE_RESISTANCE with duration input perPieceValue(80), level input 2 for FULL_SET or 1 otherwise, marked ambient. It reacts after damage rather than proving immunity to the triggering explosion.
mercurial.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

necro.summary: Before damage, FULL_SET can zero a non-environmental damage input that is at least current health when its cooldown gate permits. It calls hurtArmor with generic input 2000, raises health to 4 only if currently lower, and sets ServerPlayer cooldown input 72000. On a ServerPlayer death, a separate path requests storage of up to the counted-piece number of eligible inventory stacks, excluding Intervention and Vanishing Curse enchantments. Selection, storage return and save migration require their own acceptance tests; this is not guaranteed resurrection or preservation of a chosen item.
necro.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

nethengeic.summary: With FULL_SET and the wearer on fire, outgoing damage input is multiplied by 1.5. If the target is on fire, a separate multiplication by 1 + perPieceValue(0.1) follows. Both conditions can apply sequentially. This local method has no melee-only gate, and final damage still passes through other hooks.
nethengeic.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

omni.summary: Explosion-tagged outgoing damage input is multiplied by 1 + perPieceValue(0.1). Positive melee damage received with FULL_SET separately invokes the OMNI_ARMOUR explosion definition. The actual blast settings are outside this callback and are not assumed harmless to blocks or allies.
omni.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

poison.summary: Poison-classified incoming damage receives an armor-stage fraction perPieceValue(0.25); FULL_SET separately grants poison-damage invulnerability. A full-set Poison effect-application attempt is rejected, and server-side code schedules a resistance request one tick later with duration input 60. Damage classification and effect-application events are distinct paths.
poison.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

predatious.summary: Ranged outgoing damage input is multiplied by 1 + perPieceValue(0.1). FULL_SET retaliation requires a melee source and a living direct attacker, then requests one point of thorns damage. Unlike several other retaliation callbacks, this inspected method contains no explicit positive-new-damage guard; test blocked-hit behavior rather than assuming identical gates.
predatious.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

primordial.summary: Incoming damage is reduced only when the source has a living attacker with Wither, and either FULL_SET is present or the source is melee. The event amount is multiplied by 1 − perPieceValue(0.15). The status is checked on the attacker, not on the wearer.
primordial.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

rockbone.summary: Ranged incoming damage with FULL_SET first attempts RandomUtil.oneInNChance(10); success cancels the event. The achievement path additionally checks Projectile Protection level at least 4 on every worn armor slot. A non-cancelled ranged hit is multiplied by 1 − perPieceValue(0.1). The cancellation roll and advancement condition are separate.
rockbone.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

rosidian.summary: The released class declares only its constructor and tooltip; no local Rosid-spawn callback was found. The bounded direct-material-reference scan also found no external ROSIDIAN material reference beyond its own class/registration. That does not rule out item-ID, tag, reflection or external-mod paths. Treat the tooltip’s summon promise as unresolved in this inspected implementation until an activation path is demonstrated.
rosidian.status: Summoning activation unresolved; bounded absence evidence only

runic.summary: Magic-classified incoming damage input is multiplied by 1 − perPieceValue(0.1). FULL_SET magic damage can request ABSORPTION with duration input 200 when the player cooldown is inactive, then sets cooldown input 6000. The inspected post-damage method has no explicit positive-new-damage guard. Poison classification and engine hook order remain relevant.
runic.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

sharpshot.summary: The source must be gun-classified and the wearer must currently hold an AoAGun in the main hand, otherwise the offhand is checked. FULL_SET with the selected gun being an AoASniper uses multiplier 1.38; other cases use 1 + perPieceValue(0.07). The check uses the currently selected held-item path, not an independently verified original projectile weapon snapshot.
sharpshot.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

spaceking.summary: The released class declares only its constructor and tooltip; no local Orbling-summon or absorption callback was found. The bounded direct-material-reference scan found no external SPACEKING material reference beyond its own class/registration. Item-ID, tag, reflection and external-mod routes are outside that absence check. Keep the summon/heal promises unresolved rather than marking them operational.
spaceking.status: Summoning activation unresolved; bounded absence evidence only

utopian.summary: ServerPlayer equip callbacks add 0.05 to every skill XP modifier per ordinary piece and 0.1 for the FULL_SET marker; unequip removes the corresponding amount. This is an adjustment to the skill modifier, not a guarantee that every XP event scales identically. Verify balanced equip/unequip, requirements and reconnect, especially with compatible helmets.
utopian.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

weaken.summary: Positive melee damage from a living attacker must pass RandomUtil.percentChance(perPieceValue(0.175)). It then requests WEAKNESS with duration input 60, level input 2 for FULL_SET or 1 otherwise, marked ambient. These are helper/effect inputs rather than measured proc rates or a simulated final potion amplifier.
weaken.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

zargonite.summary: Magic-classified outgoing damage input is multiplied by 1 + perPieceValue(0.1). Its scope follows DamageUtil.isMagicDamage and the surrounding event dispatch; it is not a universal damage bonus.
zargonite.status: Released local callback review; helper and runtime limits retained

shared_rules: Equipment-change events set a flag; the pre-player-tick handler returns for dead or spectator players, processes changed equipment, checks equipment requirements, then invokes one armor tick callback per stored material container.
Material grouping and FULL_SET are separate from raw slot count. perPieceValue subtracts the FULL_SET sentinel from the EnumSet size.
Compatible-with-any-set pieces affect full-set recognition; do not assume their material containers contribute every ordinary per-piece bonus.
DamageUtil.percentDamageReduction returns existingReduction+(newDamage-existingReduction)*fraction; it is not a flat reduction of original pre-pipeline damage.
acceptance: Test one, two, three and four ordinary pieces with fall versus non-fall Alacrity damage; reconcile tooltip or implementation only after deciding intended behavior.
Test universal headpieces, equip/unequip transitions, skill-requirement changes and reconnect; do not infer effects solely from visual full-set appearance.
Test temperature thresholds and resource caps, full-inventory equipment rejection and multiplayer/event ordering on copied saves.

external_scan.scope: Direct constant-pool material-field references outside ordinary armor implementations and their material registration class. Not a proof of complete runtime behavior or absence of reflected, tag-driven, item-ID or external-mod paths.
